style: English, gentle folk song, natural male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, upright bass, brushed drums, intimate live-room sound
lyrics:
[Verse]
Paper boats along the stream
Carry pieces of a dream
Past the stones and through the shade
Follow every turn we made

[Chorus]
Take the long way home with me
Where the branches meet the sea
When the road is washed in gold
There is still a hand to hold

[Outro]
Take the long way home
